name: Aromatherapy
effect: Cure User and Allies of 1 Status Ailment of Burn, Frostbite, Paralysis, Poison, or Drowsy. If performed under Sunny Weather each target may instead have 2 Statuses cured from the above list, or cure any 1 Status afflicting them.
description: The Pokemon releases medicinal scents and vapors to refresh the user and its allies.
